checkpoints.summary:
Complete refinement pass on the Organization Admin Console:

1. **Workspace Identity**: Org is now the dominant brand throughout. ORIVIS is only visible as "Powered by ORIVIS" in sidebar footer and sign-in trust indicator. Removed "Back to ORIVIS" from sign-in.

2. **Dynamic Browser Metadata**: `OrgBrandingContext` now updates both `<title>` (e.g. "University of Port Harcourt | ORIVIS") and favicon dynamically (SVG badge with org primary color).

3. **Dashboard Hero Redesigned**: Time-based greeting ("Good Afternoon,"), org name, active election count, package name, workspace active status, and dual CTAs (Create Election + View Live). Subtle radial gradient background glow.

4. **Dashboard Widgets Improved**: Stats now show insight text (e.g. "Across all elections", "Voter participation rate"). Election cards show positions count. Storage shows contextual message based on usage %.

5. **Quick Actions**: Replaced generic actions with org workflows: Create Election, Invite Team Member, Complete Setup, View Billing. Rendered as premium glass action cards with icons.

6. **Branding Audit**: Removed ORIVIS from top bar. Removed "Infrastructure" label from sign-in top. Only trust indicators remain.

7. **Accessibility**: Added `role="navigation"`, `role="banner"`, `role="main"`, `role="alert"`, `role="status"`, `aria-label`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-current="page"`, `aria-hidden`, `aria-describedby`, `focus-visible` outline styles. Skeleton loaders use `role="status"` with `sr-only` text.

8. **Animation Polish**: Reduced dropdown transition to 0.12s. Spring damping increased to 30. Consistent 0.35s entrance on cards. `AnimatePresence` on all overlays/dropdowns.

9. **Visual Consistency**: Unified `p-6` on hero card. Consistent `gap-3` on action rows. Typography hierarchy improved (hero title `text-xl`, section headings `text-xs uppercase tracking-wider`).

10. **Component Review**: Strong TypeScript throughout. No `any` types on component props. `StatusBadge` now handles all subscription statuses. `ProgressBar` accepts optional `label` prop.

11. **Dashboard Storytelling**: Dashboard now answers: "What should I do next?" (pending tasks section), "Is my workspace healthy?" (workspace health + election integrity), "Is my package active?" (subscription widget), "What requires attention?" (attention required panel).

12. **Route Constants**: Added `ROUTES.ORG` block to constants/routes.ts.

Zero TypeScript errors.

checkpoints.summary:
Reworked org sign-in and branding to use existing auth infrastructure:

1. **Sign-in**: `/org` now uses the existing `SignIn` component (from `src/components/SignIn.tsx`) with `variant="organization"` instead of a custom branded sign-in page. Same form, same validation, same credentials — just different title text ("Organization Sign In" vs "Platform Sign In").

2. **Credentials flow**: After login via `mockLogin()`, the `AuthProvider` sets `activeOrganization` with the matched account's `organizationId`. The `OrgSignIn` page's `onSuccess` callback navigates to `/org/dashboard`.

3. **Branding resolved from auth context**: `OrgBrandingContext` now reads `activeOrganization` from `useAuth()` and calls `resolveOrgName()` + `resolveOrgBranding()` from the auth-mock to dynamically build the `OrgBrandingConfig`. The auth-mock already has `MOCK_BRANDING` per org (RSU, Meranos, GlobalTech) with different primary colors and org names.

4. **Mock data cleaned**: Removed hardcoded `ORG_BRANDING` and `ORG_ADMIN` from `src/org/mock/data.ts`. Admin info now comes from the authenticated `user` object. Static dashboard mock data is preserved.

5. **Removed branded sign-in page**: The custom `src/org/pages/SignIn.tsx` with org logo, "Powered by ORIVIS" trust badge, and inline CSS variable injection has been replaced with a thin wrapper around the shared `SignIn` component.

Credentials test: `jessica.j@rsu.edu.ng` / `Demo@1234` → RSU branding (gold). `admin@meranos.com` / `Demo@1234` → Meranos branding (indigo). `voter@globaltech.io` / `Demo@1234` → GlobalTech branding (green).

Zero TypeScript errors.
